run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T08:33:15Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is explained by failures on a single request path: frontend's GET /api/data, whose grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client call is the only frontend dependency call carrying error spans in the window (475.27 error-span increase, identical to GET, GET /api/data and executing api route (pages) /api/data; all other frontend operations read 0). The dependency behind it, the ad workload, is not serving: Deployment ad in otel-demo shows desired 1 with unavailableReplicas 1 and no ready/available replica, the Endpoints object ad holds only a notReadyAddresses entry for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5, and that pod's container ad is NotReady with restartCount 4 whose last and current states are both terminated OOMKilled exitCode 137 (08:34:29Z and 08:35:31Z), with kubelet BackOff events from 08:32:29Z to 08:40:08Z. The fault applied to that container is visible in Chaos Mesh events: Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh spawned a child every minute from 08:31:20Z, and its StressChaos events record 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' at 08:31:20Z, 08:32:20Z, 08:33:20Z, 08:34:20Z, 08:35:21Z and 08:38:10Z against the ad container's 450Mi memory limit. ad's span volume falls to zero from about 08:34 onward while other services keep reporting until the metric source ends at 08:43, and frontend-proxy shows the same count of failing ingress/egress spans (475.27 / 471.09), consistent with the proxy fronting the same /api/data requests. All nodes, including the one hosting ad and frontend, report MemoryPressure False, so node memory exhaustion is not the cause. Frontend logs were unreadable (empty read) and Jaeger holds no incident-window traces (newest frontend traces 08:23:31Z), so error text and span-level error details could not be verified; findings rest on trace-derived metrics, pod status/events and object state.

claims.text: In the window evaluated at 08:49:55 (range 08:33:15-08:49:55), frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increase is limited to one path: GET 475.27, GET /api/data 475.27, executing api route (pages) /api/data 475.27, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 475.27, tcp.connect 8.36; GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder all read 0.
Error-span increase by service over the same window: frontend 1909.43, frontend-proxy 946.36, accounting 0, payment 0, ad 0, recommendation 1.04, fraud-detection 1.04.
frontend-proxy STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans in the same window are ingress 475.27 and router frontend egress 471.09, the same order and count as frontend's failing /api/data plus GetAds spans.

Pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958) has container ad not ready with restartCount 4 and Ready condition False (reason ContainersNotReady) since 2026-11-17T08:35:32Z; lastState is terminated OOMKilled exitCode 137 finishedAt 08:34:29Z and the current state is terminated OOMKilled exitCode 137 finishedAt 08:35:31Z.

Kubelet events for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 include Warning BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container ad' 23 times between 08:32:29Z and 08:40:08Z, alongside Normal Created and Started events for container ad through 08:37:00Z.

Deployment ad in otel-demo reports desired 1, readyReplicas and availableReplicas absent, unavailableReplicas 1; its container ad sets memory limit 450Mi and request 225Mi and defines no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe.

The Endpoints object named ad in otel-demo has no ready addresses, only a notReadyAddresses entry at 100.96.2.230 with targetRef Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 on node i-0d81a0f472ebdc704, port tcp-service 8080, so the ad Service currently has no ready backend.

Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh spawned a child object every minute: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq at 08:31:20Z, -7n9mk 08:32:20Z, -8b272 08:33:20Z, -sh425 08:34:20Z, -w8tqb 08:35:20Z, -w4ct8 08:36:20Z, -w98sl 08:38:10Z, -9ncrx 08:39:05Z, with Forbid events when a previous child was still running.

StressChaos events in namespace chaos-mesh name the target explicitly: 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' at 08:31:20Z (jw6mq), 08:32:20Z (7n9mk), 08:33:20Z (8b272), 08:34:20Z (sh425), 08:35:21Z (w8tqb) and 08:38:10Z (w98sl), each followed by TimeUp and Recovered; later attempts (w4ct8, 9ncrx) failed with 'no running task found' because the previously targeted container instance was already gone.

The Chaos Mesh memory-stress Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress is the fault source observed here: its StressChaos children are the only objects recorded applying a fault to container ad of pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5, beginning 08:31:20Z, shortly before that container was OOMKilled at 08:34:29Z and 08:35:31Z and the pod entered BackOff at 08:32:29Z.

ad's own span activity stops: the 10-minute span increase for service ad decays to 0 at 08:42, and the per-service 2-minute increase for ad is 0 from 08:34 onward, while other services in the same series keep reporting (frontend roughly 3900-4600 and cart roughly 1300-1680 per 2 minutes) until the metric source ends at 08:43.
All five nodes report MemoryPressure False with reason KubeletHasSufficientMemory, including i-0d81a0f472ebdc704, which hosts both ad-554b849958-l9ft5 and frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx.

The readable ad container log stream contains normal request lines ('Targeted ad request received ...', 'no baggage found in context') up to 08:31:20Z and no error line; the previous container instance's log stream is reported unavailable ('previous terminated container ad ... not found').

Jaeger's newest frontend traces end at 2026-11-17T08:23:31Z, before the alert, and the spans in that sample all carry http.status_code 200 or rpc.grpc.status_code 0, so the sampled trace graph holds no spans from the 08:31-08:50 failure period.

Causal chain: the per-minute memory-stress from Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress pushed container ad past its 450Mi limit, the container was OOMKilled and backed off, ad lost its only endpoint (Endpoints ad has only notReadyAddresses), frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds call failed, and each failed GET /api/data produced the frontend error spans behind RequestErrorRate (alert annotation current 2.6222).

frontend-proxy is a consequence rather than an independent fault: its ingress and router frontend egress error spans match the frontend's failing /api/data plus GetAds count (475.27 versus 475.27), consistent with the proxy fronting exactly those requests.

Rejected: node-level memory shortage on i-0d81a0f472ebdc704 caused the OOMKills - that node reports MemoryPressure False with KubeletHasSufficientMemory, and the chaos events target the ad container rather than the node.

Rejected: frontend itself or its other dependencies (cart, checkout, product-catalog) are broadly failing - every other frontend operation reads 0 error-span increase in the window, and no other service shows a material error increase (accounting 0, payment 0, ad 0, recommendation 1.04, fraud-detection 1.04).

ad's own spans carry no STATUS_CODE_ERROR during the failure: ad's error-span increase is 0 while its normal GetAds, getAdsByCategory and getRandomAds traffic disappears, so the failure appears as a missing ad service rather than as ad-reported errors.

Inspect and then suspend or remove the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh, or exclude the otel-demo ad workload from it; its one-minute memory-stress cadence keeps targeting otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad.

If ad must run under this workload, revisit the 450Mi memory limit against the injected stress footprint and add readiness and liveness probes so an OOM-killed ad container leaves the Service's ready endpoints promptly and its recovery is visible.

gaps: StressChaos is a Chaos Mesh custom kind the authorized Kubernetes tools could not read (the query failed with INVALID_PARAMS), so stress size, workers and duration are known only from events, not from the object spec.

Two Jaeger queries for frontend traces in 08:30-08:45 and 08:32-08:45 returned no_data, and the newest available frontend trace sample ends at 08:23:31Z, so the failing GetAds spans' error tags and error details could not be read; error evidence is metric-based only.

frontend container log reads returned no lines both without a filter (08:50:31Z window) and with an error filter, and the 08:32-08:45 read returned no_data, so no frontend application error text is available.

kube-state-metrics queries returned no_data for kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready/available for deployment ad and for kube_deployment.*/kube_pod_container.* metric names, so the ad readiness and restart timeline rests on pod status, Endpoints state and events rather than a metric timeseries.

The alerting rule named RequestErrorRate was not found (list_prometheus_rules returned no_data), so the exact alert expression and the meaning of the 2.6222 value could not be verified; alert labels and annotations are only the supplied Alertmanager metadata.
A query for rpc_* service_name label values returned no_data, so rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count could not be used and the grpc status codes behind the failing GetAds calls are unknown.

Kubernetes events supplied end at 08:40:08Z, so activity after that (for example whether further chaos experiments were applied) is unknown; the ad pod is still NotReady in the 08:50:57Z object snapshot.
Queries for networkpolicies and resourcequotas in otel-demo returned no_data, so their absence in the namespace is not established and a network or quota contributor cannot be fully excluded.
Change history is not an integrated source in this Run, so no deployment or configuration change history could be correlated with the 08:31Z onset.
next_steps: Have a human with Chaos Mesh access read Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and its StressChaos children (stress size, workers, duration, target selector) to confirm the injected memory load against ad's 450Mi limit.
Confirm whether the schedule is intended to continue firing past 08:39Z; if it is, expect continued ad unavailability and repeated frontend RequestErrorRate alerts.
After any change, re-check Deployment ad ready and available replicas, Endpoints ad ready addresses, and frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans to confirm recovery.
